messages.subject: Re: R.3.1.2/ deducer/JGR not working properly on window 8.1
parts:
When you open up the JGR console you get a new R session which doesn’t have any of the packages you had in your other R session loaded. Did you try loading Deducer in JGR using either library(Deducer) or using the “Packages and Data” menu item?


Ian
